mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article_like_state(user_id, article_id, liked, version) VALUES (#{userId}, #{articleId}, 0, 0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE version = article_like_state.version
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, article_id, liked, version FROM article_like_state WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND article_id = #{articleId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE article_like_state SET liked=#{state.liked}, version=#{state.version}, updated_at=NOW(3) WHERE user_id=#{state.userId} AND article_id=#{state.articleId}
UPDATE article_like_count SET like_count=like_count+#{delta} WHERE article_id=#{articleId} AND like_count+#{delta} >= 0
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM article WHERE id=#{articleId} AND hidden=FALSE)
SELECT user_id, article_id, liked, version FROM article_like_state WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND article_id IN #{id}
SELECT article_id, like_count FROM article_like_count WHERE article_id IN #{id}
